items.headline: Morgan Stanley and other lenders explore moving data center construction loan exposure to private credit
items.note: Banks looking to offload data-center construction risk signals tighter bank appetite and shifts risk to private-credit funds; secondary source, unverified.

items.headline: CoreWeave 5-year CDS spiked above ~1,200bp and 2032 bonds yield ~16% ahead of Q3 earnings
items.source: FourWeekMBA / TechJack (secondary, citing Deutsche Bank via CNBC)
items.note: Distressed-level CDS and bond yields show the market pricing real default risk on the largest neocloud borrower (~$50B debt); figures not confirmed from primary sources.
